description: Each month, holds whichever of E-mini S&P 500 and 10-year Treasury note futures has the higher 12-month return. Backtested on FinzData futures: each market is its front-month contract rolled on the FinzData roll calendar, as an excess-return index (no interest on collateral), 5 bps costs per trade, re-run free on full history.
title: Stock-bond futures dual momentum · /ES vs /ZN (after Antonacci 2014)
